content_sections.heading: UPSC EPFO APFC Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: UPSC has announced 80 vacancies for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner in EPFO. Out of the total vacancies, 3 vacancies are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates possessing a Graduate Degree from a recognized university or equivalent can apply for the Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner post, subject to fulfilling the other eligibility conditions prescribed by UPSC. Post Name: Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) Qualification: Graduate Degree Candidates must satisfy the prescribed age and other eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: UR / EWS: Maximum 35 years OBC: Maximum 38 years SC / ST: Maximum 40 years PwBD: Age limit is further relaxable by up to 10 years for vacancies identified as suitable and/or reserved for PwBD candidates. The crucial date for determining the age limit is 11 September 2026 .
